newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent ends steady testing $18.24 resistance.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent ends steady testing $18.24 resistance.

text.p: IPE Brent crude oil futures ended steady off from the lows and re-testing resistance at $18.24.
Traders said the market was technically healthy with strong trendline support giving it a solid bottom.
The August Brent last traded 16 cents a barrel lower at $18.22 after earlier testing but failing to convincingly break trendline support at around $18.11.

Traders said talk that Iraq and the U.N. may resolve the oil for food aid plan and a bearish U.S. stocks report were countered by tighter European supplies of both crude and products and solid technical resistance.
Short-covering just before the NYMEX opening and following a report that European crude and products stocks had fallen in June pushed Brent and gas oil sharply higher.

Brent cut through a wide band of resistance between $18.24 up to a brief break of $18.40 a barrel and gas oil bounced off resistance at $164.00 a tonne. But sentiment turned weaker again and selling pressure pushed both markets back down to test what are proving to be strong support levels again.
Below $18.10 lies a further line of support at $17.97.
July gas oil last traded 25 cents down at $162.75 a tonne it too was holding key support at $162.25 a tonne at the close.
